baselines.name: Tuned simulated annealing
baselines.command: uv run --with numpy --with scipy python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench
baselines.notes: Standard local-search baseline used in prior verification.

baselines.name: SciPy basin hopping
baselines.command: uv run --with numpy --with scipy python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench
baselines.notes: Useful but must be tuned; defaults are weak.

baselines.name: SciPy differential evolution
baselines.command: uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with cma python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench --methods DE
baselines.notes: Standard derivative-free optimizer wired by the Heilbronn benchmark as method DE.

baselines.name: CMA-ES
baselines.command: uv run --with cma --with numpy python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench
baselines.notes: Strong optimizer bar for smooth or relaxed formulations.
